parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim from the proof of Lemma (ii), which is the sole engine of Liu's lower bound (Section 3 depends entirely on it). The whole justification of the inductive step is the clause 'adding the next column ... preserves this alternative'; no case analysis is given (why can the new column's strips not cancel the surviving odd strip, and why do adversarial cuts elsewhere leave it odd?), 'uncancelled' is never defined in the adversarial setting of (ii), and the strip description is incoherent as written (two copies of all preceding strips is 2(2^{j+1}−1), not 2^{j+1}). No other part of the text proves (ii); the tracking notes merely cite lemmas/refinement.md. Minor caveat: 'requires at least s+1 cuts' is actually immediate (each cut lies in one original column), but the central complaint — the preservation step is asserted, not proved — is correct, so the all-n lower bound is not established.
